capabilities.why: Snapshots enable instantaneous capture of microVM memory and disk state immediately after complex dependency setup, allowing instant rollback to a clean checkpoint before running untrusted reproduction scripts without repeating costly 3-minute environment builds.

Safety hooks intercept every command invocation pre-execution to inspect syntax, evaluate network/filesystem risks, and enforce deterministic blocking of dangerous payloads (such as fork bombs, host escape vectors, or credential exfiltration) before reaching the guest kernel.

Deterministic network policy isolates untrusted guest workloads by cutting off public outbound routing or restricting network access to explicit allowlists, successfully eliminating prompt-injection exfiltration attacks attempting to leak injected canary secrets.
